script:
C0=$(control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --field .)
LONG=$(python3 -c 'print("x" * 201)')
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE/fork" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Source conversation not found' --save F10.fork-errors/unknown-source
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --json '{"from_event_id": "qa-f10-nope"}' --expect 404 \
  --check detail eq 'Unknown from_event_id: qa-f10-nope' --save F10.fork-errors/unknown-event
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --json "{\"id\": \"$S\"}" --expect 409 \
  --check detail eq "Conversation with id $S already exists" --save F10.fork-errors/taken-by-source
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --json "{\"id\": \"$FN\"}" --expect 409 --check detail eq "Conversation with id $FN already exists"
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --json '{"tags": {"Bad-Key": "x"}}' --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc.1 eq tags --save F10.fork-errors/bad-tag
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --json "{\"title\": \"$LONG\"}" --expect 422 --check detail.0.type eq string_too_long
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid/fork --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc.1 eq conversation_id
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --check . eq "$C0" --save F10.fork-errors/count-after
test "$(control-agent-server state ls 'server/workspace/conversations/*/meta.json' | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["count"])')" = "$C0"
